prompt:
Rebuild a clean flat-front football jersey (01 product style).

IMAGE 1 = GEOMETRY MASTER (kit 18).
Copy ONLY: silhouette, torso length, raglan, short sleeves, crew collar
CONSTRUCTION (thickness, opening, rib proportions), gray inner cue,
cuff/hem proportions. Do NOT keep IMAGE 1 body/sleeve/collar paint.

IMAGE 2 = PAINT MASTER (kit 23).
Copy ALL paint onto IMAGE 1 shape: body and sleeves with alternating
yellow and navy horizontal HOOPS, collar BAND color (solid navy matching
the dark hoop navy), cuff paint if any. Clean chest — no logos/text/numbers.
Ignore IMAGE 2 overall size if different; use IMAGE 1 proportions.
Discard IMAGE 2 wrong collar shape (white V or any non-kit-18 crew); keep only its paint/colors/pattern.

IMAGE 3 = design sheet (kit 23 color/pattern check only).
Confirm yellow/navy hoop colors and SOLID NAVY collar band matching dark hoops.
Do NOT copy logos, numbers, shorts, or typography.

Critical:
1) Geometry = IMAGE 1 (kit 18 class). Collar SHAPE stays kit 18.
2) Paint = IMAGE 2 (kit 23 yellow/navy horizontal hoops).
3) Collar band color = kit 23 paint/design solid navy — never force white from kit 11,
   never keep geometry kit’s yellow collar, never keep kit 21 white collar.
4) Transparent flat front, no mannequin, no text.
